breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly changed the mesh patches for front/back to 'empty' and correctly set empty BCs for U, T, p, and p_rgh on front/back. However, for the turbulence fields (k, epsilon, nut, alphat), the generated specification still states 'noSlip on front/back' instead of 'empty on front/back' as required by the ground truth. This means the inconsistency was only partially resolved.
